# Chinese Tea Guide

> A practical guide to Chinese tea — the six major types, 21 famous teas with brewing and buying guides, tea regions, brewing methods, tea culture, and how to choose the right tea for your taste. No sponsored recommendations.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.chin-tea.com/): Start here — overview of the six tea types, famous teas, and how to navigate the guide
- [The Six Types of Chinese Tea](https://www.chin-tea.com/types/): Green, white, yellow, oolong, black, and dark tea explained
- [Green Tea](https://www.chin-tea.com/types/green/): Unoxidized teas — Longjing, Biluochun, Maofeng and more
- [White Tea](https://www.chin-tea.com/types/white/): Minimally processed — Silver Needle, White Peony, Shou Mei
- [Yellow Tea](https://www.chin-tea.com/types/yellow/): The rare "sealed yellowing" category, including Junshan Yinzhen
- [Oolong Tea](https://www.chin-tea.com/types/oolong/): Semi-oxidized — Tie Guan Yin, Da Hong Pao, Phoenix Dan Cong
- [Black Tea](https://www.chin-tea.com/types/black/): Fully oxidized — Keemun, Dian Hong, Lapsang Souchong, Jin Jun Mei
- [Dark Tea](https://www.chin-tea.com/types/dark/): Post-fermented — sheng and shou Pu-erh, Liu Bao

## Famous Teas

- [All 21 Famous Teas](https://www.chin-tea.com/teas/): Every tea's flavor profile, brewing parameters, and buying tips
- [Comparison Table](https://www.chin-tea.com/compare/): All 21 teas side by side — filterable by type and flavour
- [Best Chinese Teas](https://www.chin-tea.com/best-teas/): Ranked picks for every budget
- [Longjing (Dragon Well)](https://www.chin-tea.com/teas/longjing/): Example tea page — brewing, pricing, quality checks, common scams

- [Brewing Guide](https://www.chin-tea.com/guides/brewing/): Temperatures, ratios, and timing

- [Flavour Guide](https://www.chin-tea.com/flavours/): Find tea by taste preference

## Policy

Crawling for AI search citations and training is permitted. Content is updated quarterly; last verified August 2026. For corrections, email hello@chin-tea.com.
